title: Physics-Based Learning of the Wave Speed Landscape in Complex Media
summary: Wave velocity is a key parameter for imaging complex media, but in vivo measurements are typically limited to reflection geometries, where only backscattered waves from short-scale heterogeneities are accessible. As a result, conventional reflection imaging fails to recover large-scale variations of the wave velocity landscape. Here we show that matrix imaging overcomes this limitation by exploiting the quality of wave focusing as an intrinsic guide star. We model wave propagation as a trainable multi-layer network that leverages optimization and deep learning tools to infer the wave velocity distribution. We validate this approach through ultrasound experiments on tissue-mimicking phantoms and human breast tissues, demonstrating its potential for tumour detection and characterization. Our method is broadly applicable to any kind of waves and media for which a reflection matrix can be measured.

title: Joint Background-Anomaly-Noise Decomposition for Robust Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection via Constrained Convex Optimization
comments: Submitted to IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing
summary: We propose a novel hyperspectral (HS) anomaly detection method that is robust to various types of noise. Most existing HS anomaly detection methods are designed without explicit consideration of noise or are based on the assumption of Gaussian noise. However, in real-world situations, observed HS images are often degraded by various types of noise, such as sparse noise and stripe noise, due to sensor failure or calibration errors, significantly affecting the detection performance. To address this problem, this article establishes a robust HS anomaly detection method with a mechanism that can properly remove mixed noise while separating background and anomaly parts. Specifically, we newly formulate a constrained convex optimization problem to decompose background and anomaly parts, and three types of noise from a given HS image. Then, we develop an efficient algorithm based on a preconditioned variant of a primal-dual splitting method to solve this problem. Experimental results using six real HS datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves detection accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art methods on original images and exhibits significantly higher robustness in scenarios where various types of mixed noise are added.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing

title: ResSR: A Computationally Efficient Residual Approach to Super-Resolving Multispectral Images
summary:
Multispectral imaging (MSI) plays a critical role in material classification, environmental monitoring, and remote sensing. However, MSI sensors typically have wavelength-dependent resolution, which limits downstream analysis. MSI super-resolution (MSI-SR) methods address this limitation by reconstructing all bands at a common high spatial resolution. Existing methods can achieve high reconstruction quality but often rely on spatially-coupled optimization or large learning-based models, leading to significant computational cost and limiting their use in large-scale or time-critical settings.
  In this paper, we introduce ResSR, a computationally efficient, model-based MSI-SR method that achieves high-quality reconstruction without supervised training or spatially-coupled optimization. Notably, ResSR decouples spectral and spatial processing into separate branches, which are then combined in a residual correction step. The spectral branch uses singular value decomposition plus a spatially-decoupled approximate forward model to upsample the MSI, while the spatial branch uses bicubic upsampling. The residual correction step combines these branches to recover accurate spectral and spatial MSI features. ResSR achieves comparable or improved reconstruction quality relative to existing MSI-SR methods while being 2$\times$ to 10$\times$ faster. Code is available at https://github.com/hdsullivan/ResSR.

title: GroundGazer: Camera-based indoor localization of mobile robots with millimeter accuracy at low cost
summary: Highly accurate indoor localization systems with mm positioning accuracy are currently very expensive. They include laser trackers, total stations, and motion capture systems relying on multiple high-end cameras. In this work, we introduce a high-accuracy, planar indoor localization system named GroundGazer (GG) for autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). GG estimates the AMR's position with mm and its heading with sub-degree accuracy. The system requires only a monocular (fisheye) camera, a chessboard floor, and an optional laser diode. Our system is simple and low-cost, easy to set up, portable, robust, scalable to large areas and robot swarms, and extendable to 3D position and orientation estimation.

title: Observer-Usable Information as a Task-specific Image Quality Metric
summary: Objective, task-based measures of image quality (IQ) have been widely advocated for assessing and optimizing medical imaging technologies. Besides signal detection theory-based measures, information-theoretic quantities have been proposed to quantify task-based IQ. For example, task-specific information (TSI), defined as the mutual information between an image and a task variable, represents an optimal measure of how informative an image is for performing a specified task. However, like the ideal observer from signal detection theory, TSI does not quantify the amount of task-relevant information in an image that can be exploited by a sub-ideal observer. A recently proposed relaxation of TSI, termed predictive V-information (V-info), removes this limitation and can quantify the utility of an image with consideration of a specified family of sub-ideal observers. In this study, for the first time, we introduce and investigate V-info as an objective, task-specific IQ metric. To corroborate its usefulness, a stylized magnetic resonance image restoration problem is considered in which V-info is employed to quantify signal detection or discrimination performance. The presented results show that V-info correlates with area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve for binary tasks, while being readily applicable to multi-class (>2) tasks where ROC analysis is challenging. Notably, V-info exhibits greater sensitivity in scenarios where conventional metrics saturate. These findings demonstrate that V-info represents a new objective IQ measure that can complement conventional signal detection theory-based ones.

title: DiffRhythm 2: Efficient and High Fidelity Song Generation via Block Flow Matching
summary: Generating full-length, high-quality songs is challenging, as it requires maintaining long-term coherence both across text and music modalities and within the music modality itself. Existing non-autoregressive (NAR) frameworks, while capable of producing high-quality songs, often struggle with the alignment between lyrics and vocal. Concurrently, catering to diverse musical preferences necessitates reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). However, existing methods often rely on merging multiple models during multi-preference optimization, which results in significant performance degradation. To address these challenges, we introduce DiffRhythm 2, an end-to-end framework designed for high-fidelity, controllable song generation. To tackle the lyric alignment problem, DiffRhythm 2 employs a semi-autoregressive architecture based on block flow matching. This design enables faithful alignment of lyrics to singing vocals without relying on external labels and constraints, all while preserving the high generation quality and efficiency of NAR models. To make this framework computationally tractable for long sequences, we implement a music variational autoencoder (VAE) that achieves a low frame rate of 5 Hz while still enabling high-fidelity audio reconstruction. In addition, to overcome the limitations of multi-preference optimization in RLHF, we propose cross-pair preference optimization. This method effectively mitigates the performance drop typically associated with model merging, allowing for more robust optimization across diverse human preferences. We further enhance musicality and structural coherence by introducing stochastic block representation alignment loss.

title: SPEAR: A Unified SSL Framework for Learning Speech and Audio Representations
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has significantly advanced acoustic representation learning. However, most existing models are optimised for either speech or audio event understanding, resulting in a persistent gap between these two domains. We address this gap with SPEAR (SPEech and Audio Representations), a self-supervised framework that distils complementary knowledge from a speech-focused SSL teacher and a general-audio SSL teacher into a single unified model. SPEAR applies multi-codebook vector quantisation to continuous teacher representations to produce fine-grained discrete tokens that capture both semantic and acoustic information. To effectively integrate these heterogeneous representations, SPEAR jointly predicts them given a masked input with an asymmetric pre-training loss. We further improve robustness in complex sound scenes through a novel token mixing mechanism. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPEAR consistently outperforms existing unified speech and audio models. SPEAR establishes a new state-of-the-art on the SUPERB benchmark, surpassing WavLM Large on 12 of 15 tasks, while achieving competitive performance on the HEAR benchmark. These results position SPEAR as a versatile foundation for general-purpose speech and audio representation learning. The code and pre-trained models will be released.

title: On the Performance of Tri-Hybrid Beamforming Using Pinching Antennas
summary: The Pinching-Antenna System (PASS) reconfigures wireless channels through \emph{pinching beamforming}, in which the active positions of pinching antennas (PAs) along dielectric waveguides are optimized to shape the radiation pattern. This article investigates the performance of PASS-enabled tri-hybrid beamforming, where pinched waveguides are integrated with a hybrid digital-analog beamformer to mitigate path loss and enhance spectral efficiency. The channel capacity of the proposed system is characterized by deriving the optimal tri-hybrid beamformer at both the digital and analog domains, as well as the optimal placement of PAs. Closed-form upper and lower bounds of the channel capacity are obtained, leading to a capacity scaling law with respect to the number of PAs. Numerical results verify the tightness of the derived bounds and demonstrate that applying PASS to tri-hybrid beamforming yields a significant performance gain over conventional hybrid beamforming under the same number of radio-frequency chains.

title: Fetpype: An Open-Source Pipeline for Reproducible Fetal Brain MRI Analysis
comments: 6 pages, 1 figure; submitted to the Journal of Open Source Software (JOSS)
summary: Fetal brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is crucial for assessing neurodevelopment in utero. However, fetal MRI analysis remains technically challenging due to fetal motion, low signal-to-noise ratio, and the need for complex multi-step processing pipelines. These pipelines typically include motion correction, super-resolution reconstruction, tissue segmentation, and cortical surface extraction. While specialized tools exist for each individual processing step, integrating them into a robust, reproducible, and user-friendly end-to-end workflow remains difficult. This fragmentation limits reproducibility across studies and hinders the adoption of advanced fetal neuroimaging methods in both research and clinical contexts. Fetpype addresses this gap by providing a standardized, modular, and reproducible framework for fetal brain MRI preprocessing and analysis, enabling researchers to process raw T2-weighted acquisitions through to derived volumetric and surface-based outputs within a unified workflow. Fetpype is publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/fetpype/fetpype.
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure; submitted to the Journal of Open Source Software (JOSS)

title: A High-Performance Training-Free Pipeline for Robust Random Telegraph Signal Characterization via Adaptive Wavelet-Based Denoising and Bayesian Digitization Methods
summary: Random telegraph signal (RTS) analysis is increasingly important for characterizing meaningful temporal fluctuations in physical, chemical, and biological systems. The simplest RTS arises from discrete stochastic switching events between two binary states, quantified by their transition amplitude and dwell times in each state. Quantitative analysis of RTSs provides valuable insights into microscopic processes such as charge trapping in semiconductors. However, analyzing RTS becomes considerably complex when signals exhibit multi-level structures or are corrupted by background white or pink noise. To address these challenges and support high-throughput RTS characterization, we propose a modular, training-free signal processing pipeline that integrates adaptive dual-tree complex wavelet transform (DTCWT) denoising with a lightweight Bayesian digitization strategy. The adaptive DTCWT denoiser incorporates autonomous parameter selection rules for its decomposition level and thresholds, optimizing white noise suppression without manual tuning. Our Bayesian digitizer formulates RTS level assignment as a probabilistic latent-state inference problem incorporating temporal regularization without iterative optimization, effectively resolving binary trap states even under residual notorious background pink noise. Quantitative benchmarking on large synthetic datasets with known ground truth demonstrates improved RTS reconstruction accuracy, trap-state resolution, and dwell-time estimation across diverse noise regimes and multi-trap scenarios, while achieving up to 83x speedups over classical and neural baselines. Qualitative validation on experimental RTS data when no ground truth is available illustrates practical usability and flexibility for real-time or large-scale analysis in real measurement settings.

title: De-Linearizing Agent Traces: Bayesian Inference of Latent Partial Orders for Efficient Execution
summary: I agents increasingly execute procedural workflows as sequential action traces, which obscures latent concurrency and induces repeated step-by-step reasoning. We introduce BPOP, a Bayesianframework that infers a latent dependency partial order from noisy linearized traces. BPOP models traces as stochastic linear extensions of an underlying graph and performs efficient MCMC inference via a tractable frontier-softmax likelihood that avoids #P-hard marginalization over linear extensions. We evaluate on our open-sourced Cloud-IaC-6, a suite of cloud provisioning tasks with heterogeneous LLM-generated traces, and WFCommons scientific workflows. BPOP recover dependency structure more accurately than trace-only and process-mining baselines, and the inferred graphs support a compiled executor that prunes irrelevant context, yielding substantial reductions in token usage and execution time.

title: On the consistent and scalable detection of spatial patterns
summary: Detecting spatial patterns is fundamental to scientific discovery, yet current methods lack statistical consensus and face computational barriers when applied to large-scale spatial omics datasets. We unify major approaches through a single quadratic form and derive general consistency conditions. We reveal that several widely used methods, including Moran's I, are inconsistent, and propose scalable corrections. The resulting test enables robust pattern detection across millions of spatial locations and single-cell lineage-tracing datasets.

title: Scalable non-separable spatio-temporal Gaussian process models for large-scale short-term weather prediction
summary: Monitoring daily weather fields is critical for climate science, agriculture, and environmental planning, yet fully probabilistic spatio-temporal models become computationally prohibitive at continental scale. We present a case study on short-term forecasting of daily maximum temperature and precipitation across the conterminous United States using novel scalable spatio-temporal Gaussian process methodology. Building on three approximation families - inducing-point methods (FITC), Vecchia approximations, and a hybrid Vecchia-inducing-point full-scale approach (VIF) - we introduce three extensions that address key bottlenecks in large space-time settings: (i) a scalable correlation-based neighbor selection strategy for Vecchia approximations with point-referenced data, enabling accurate conditioning under complex dependence structures, (ii) a space-time kMeans++ inducing-point selection algorithm, and (iii) GPU-accelerated implementations of computationally expensive operations, including matrix operations and neighbor searches. Using both synthetic experiments and a large NOAA station dataset containing approximately 1.7 million space-time observations, we analyze the models with respect to predictive performance, parameter estimation, and computational efficiency. Our results demonstrate that scalable Gaussian process models can yield accurate continental-scale forecasts while remaining computationally feasible, offering practical tools for weather applications.

title: Ionospheric Observations from the ISS: Overcoming Noise Challenges in Signal Extraction
summary: The Electric Propulsion Electrostatic Analyzer Experiment (ÈPÈE) is a compact ion energy bandpass filter deployed on the International Space Station (ISS) in March 2023 and providing continuous measurements through April 2024. This period coincides with the Solar Cycle 25 maximum, capturing unique observations of solar activity extremes in the mid- to low-latitude regions of the topside ionosphere. From these in situ spectra we derive plasma parameters that inform space-weather impacts on satellite navigation and radio communication. We present a statistical processing pipeline for ÈPÈE that (i) estimates the instrument noise floor, (ii) accounts for irregular temporal sampling, and (iii) extracts ionospheric signals. Rather than discarding noisy data, the method learns a baseline noise model and fits the measurement surface using a scaled Vecchia Gaussian process approximation, recovering values typically rejected by thresholding. The resulting products increase data coverage and enable noise-assisted monitoring of ionospheric variability.

title: Empirical Bayes Shrinkage of Functional Effects, with Application to Analysis of Dynamic eQTLs
summary: We introduce functional adaptive shrinkage (FASH), an empirical Bayes method for joint analysis of observation units in which each unit estimates an effect function at several values of a continuous condition variable. The ideas in this paper are motivated by dynamic expression quantitative trait locus (eQTL) studies, which aim to characterize how genetic effects on gene expression vary with time or another continuous condition. FASH integrates a broad family of Gaussian processes defined through linear differential operators into an empirical Bayes shrinkage framework, enabling adaptive smoothing and borrowing of information across units. This provides improved estimation of effect functions and principled hypothesis testing, allowing straightforward computation of significance measures such as local false discovery and false sign rates. To encourage conservative inferences, we propose a simple prior- adjustment method that has theoretical guarantees and can be more broadly used with other empirical Bayes methods. We illustrate the benefits of FASH by reanalyzing dynamic eQTL data on cardiomyocyte differentiation from induced pluripotent stem cells. FASH identified novel dynamic eQTLs, revealed diverse temporal effect patterns, and provided improved power compared with the original analysis. More broadly, FASH offers a flexible statistical framework for joint analysis of functional data, with applications extending beyond genomics. To facilitate use of FASH in dynamic eQTL studies and other settings, we provide an accompanying R package at https: //github.com/stephenslab/fashr.

title: Blinded sample size re-estimation accounting for uncertainty in mid-trial estimation
summary: For randomized controlled trials to be conclusive, it is important to set the target sample size accurately at the design stage. Comparing two normal populations, the sample size calculation requires specification of the variance other than the treatment effect and misspecification can lead to underpowered studies. Blinded sample size re-estimation is an approach to minimize the risk of inconclusive studies. Existing methods proposed to use the total (one-sample) variance that is estimable from blinded data without knowledge of the treatment allocation. We demonstrate that, since the expectation of this estimator is greater than or equal to the true variance, the one-sample variance approach can be regarded as providing an upper bound of the variance in blind reviews. This worst-case evaluation can likely reduce a risk of underpowered studies. However, blinded reviews of small sample size may still lead to underpowered studies. We propose a refined method accounting for estimation error in blind reviews using an upper confidence limit of the variance. A similar idea had been proposed in the setting of external pilot studies. Furthermore, we developed a method to select an appropriate confidence level so that the re-estimated sample size attains the target power. Numerical studies showed that our method works well and outperforms existing methods. The proposed procedure is motivated and illustrated by recent randomized clinical trials.

title: Bayesian spatiotemporal modelling of political violence and conflict events using discrete-time Hawkes processes
summary:
The monitoring of conflict risk in the humanitarian sector is largely based on simple historic averages. The overarching goal of this work is to assess the potential for using a more statistically rigorous approach to monitor the risk of political violence and conflict events in practice, and thereby improve our understanding of their temporal and spatial patterns, to inform preventative measures.
  In particular, a Bayesian, spatiotemporal variant of the Hawkes process is fitted to data gathered by the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED) project to obtain sub-national estimates of conflict risk in South Asia over time and space. Our model can effectively estimate the risk level of these events within a statistically sound framework, with a more precise understanding of uncertainty than was previously possible. The model also provides insights into differences in behaviours between countries and conflict types. We also show how our model can be used to monitor short and long term trends, and that it is more stable and robust to outliers compared to current practices that rely on historical averages.

title: Attenuation Bias with Latent Predictors
summary: Many core concepts in political science are latent and therefore can only be measured with error. Measurement error in a predictor attenuates slope coefficient estimates in regression, biasing them toward zero. We show that widely used strategies for correcting attenuation bias -- including instrumental variables and the method of composition -- are themselves biased when applied to latent regressors, sometimes even more than simple regression ignoring the measurement error altogether. We derive a correlation-based correction using split-sample measurement strategies. Rather than assuming a particular estimation strategy for the latent trait, our approach is modular and can be easily deployed with a wide variety of latent trait measurement strategies, including additive score, factor, or machine learning models, requiring no joint estimation while yielding consistent slopes under standard assumptions. Simulations and applications show stronger relationships after our correction, sometimes by as much as 50%. Open-source software implements the procedure. Results underscore that latent predictors demand tailored error correction; otherwise, conventional practice can exacerbate bias.

title: Green Finance and Carbon Emissions: A Nonlinear and Interaction Analysis Using Bayesian Additive Regression Trees
summary: As a core policy tool for China in addressing climate risks, green finance plays a strategically important role in shaping carbon mitigation outcomes. This study investigates the nonlinear and interaction effects of green finance on carbon emission intensity (CEI) using Chinese provincial panel data from 2000 to 2022. The Climate Physical Risk Index (CPRI) is incorporated into the analytical framework to assess its potential role in shaping carbon outcomes. We employ Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) to capture complex nonlinear relationships and interaction pathways, and use SHapley Additive exPlanations values to enhance model interpretability. Results show that the Green Finance Index (GFI) has a statistically significant inverted U-shaped effect on CEI, with notable regional heterogeneity. Contrary to expectations, CPRI does not show a significant impact on carbon emissions. Further analysis reveals that in high energy consumption scenarios, stronger green finance development contributes to lower CEI. These findings highlight the potential of green finance as an effective instrument for carbon intensity reduction, especially in energy-intensive contexts, and underscore the importance of accounting for nonlinear effects and regional disparities when designing and implementing green financial policies.

AI.title_translation: 绿色金融与碳排放：使用贝叶斯加性回归树进行非线性与交互分析
AI.tldr: 本研究使用贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）分析了中国绿色金融对碳排放强度（CEI）的非线性及交互效应，并考虑了气候物理风险指数（CPRI）。研究发现，绿色金融指数（GFI）对CEI呈显著的倒U型影响，且存在地区异质性。CPRI对碳排放无显著影响。在高能耗情景下，绿色金融发展有助于降低CEI。
AI.motivation: 本研究旨在探究绿色金融作为中国应对气候风险的核心政策工具，在塑造碳减排结果方面的作用，特别是其对碳排放强度（CEI）的非线性及交互效应。
AI.method: 研究采用了贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）模型来捕捉复杂的非线性关系和交互路径，并结合SHapley加性解释值（SHAP）来增强模型的可解释性。分析使用了中国2000年至2022年的省级面板数据。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，绿色金融指数（GFI）对碳排放强度（CEI）存在统计学上显著的倒U型效应，并且这种效应表现出明显的区域异质性。与预期相反，气候物理风险指数（CPRI）对碳排放没有显著影响。进一步的分析表明，在高能耗的情景下，更强的绿色金融发展有助于降低CEI。
AI.conclusion: 本研究强调了绿色金融作为减少碳强度的有效工具的潜力，特别是在能源密集型背景下。研究结果表明，在设计和实施绿色金融政策时，考虑非线性效应和区域差异至关重要。
AI.translation: 作为中国应对气候风险的核心政策工具，绿色金融在塑造碳减排成果方面发挥着战略性作用。本研究利用2000年至2022年中国省级面板数据，探究了绿色金融对碳排放强度（CEI）的非线性及交互效应。将气候物理风险指数（CPRI）纳入分析框架，以评估其在塑造碳结果方面的潜在作用。我们采用贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）来捕捉复杂的非线性关系和交互路径，并使用SHapley加性解释值（SHAP）来增强模型的可解释性。结果表明，绿色金融指数（GFI）对CEI具有统计学上显著的倒U型效应，并存在显著的区域异质性。与预期相反，CPRI并未对碳排放产生显著影响。进一步分析显示，在高能耗情景下，更强的绿色金融发展有助于降低CEI。这些发现凸显了绿色金融作为减少碳强度的有效工具的潜力，尤其是在能源密集型背景下，并强调了在制定和实施绿色金融政策时考虑非线性效应和区域差异的重要性。
AI.summary: 本研究利用贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）和SHAP值，分析了中国2000-2022年省级面板数据中，绿色金融指数（GFI）和气候物理风险指数（CPRI）对碳排放强度（CEI）的非线性及交互效应。研究发现GFI对CEI呈现倒U型影响，存在区域差异，而CPRI无显著影响。在高能耗情景下，绿色金融发展能有效降低CEI，表明其在碳减排中的重要作用，并提示政策制定需考虑非线性及区域因素。
AI.keywords: 绿色金融, 碳排放强度, 非线性效应, 贝叶斯加性回归树, 交互效应
AI.comments: 该研究利用先进的贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）模型，有效地捕捉了绿色金融与碳排放之间的复杂非线性关系和交互效应，这比传统的线性模型更具优势。SHAP值的应用增强了模型的可解释性，使得研究结果更易于理解和应用。研究发现了绿色金融对碳排放的倒U型影响，这为政策制定提供了新的视角，即绿色金融的效益可能存在一个最优区间。然而，研究未发现气候物理风险指数（CPRI）的显著影响，这可能与数据、模型设定或风险传导机制的复杂性有关，值得进一步深入探讨。此外，研究强调了区域异质性和高能耗情景下的作用，这对于制定因地制宜的绿色金融政策具有重要的实践意义。总体而言，该研究在理论和实证上都具有较高的价值和创新性。

title: Matrix-Response Generalized Linear Mixed Model with Applications to Longitudinal Brain Images
comments: This research was supported by the National Institutes of Health under grant R01-AG073259
summary: Longitudinal brain imaging data facilitate the monitoring of structural and functional alterations in individual brains across time, offering essential understanding of dynamic neurobiological mechanisms. Such data improve sensitivity for detecting early biomarkers of disease progression and enhance the evaluation of intervention effects. While recent matrix-response regression models can relate static brain networks to external predictors, there remain few statistical methods for longitudinal brain networks, especially those derived from high-dimensional imaging data. We introduce a matrix-response generalized linear mixed model that accommodates longitudinal brain networks and identifies edges whose connectivity is influenced by external predictors. An efficient Monte Carlo Expectation-Maximization algorithm is developed for parameter estimation. Extensive simulations demonstrate effective identification of covariate-related network components and accurate parameter estimation. We further demonstrate the usage of the proposed method through applications to diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) and functional MRI (fMRI) datasets.
comment: This research was supported by the National Institutes of Health under grant R01-AG073259

AI.title_translation: 带有纵向脑图像应用的矩阵响应广义线性混合模型
AI.tldr: 为了分析纵向脑网络，我们开发了一种新的矩阵响应广义线性混合模型，它使用MCEM算法进行参数估计，并在DTI和fMRI数据上表现良好，有助于检测疾病生物标志物。
AI.motivation: 现有的矩阵响应回归模型主要用于静态脑网络，而针对纵向脑网络（特别是源自高维成像数据）的统计方法仍然稀缺，这阻碍了对动态神经生物学机制的理解以及早期生物标志物的检测。
AI.method: 提出了一种矩阵响应广义线性混合模型（matrix-response generalized linear mixed model），并开发了一种高效的蒙特卡洛期望最大化（Monte Carlo Expectation-Maximization, MCEM）算法来进行参数估计。
AI.result: 广泛的模拟研究证明了该方法能够有效识别与协变量相关的网络组成部分，并实现准确的参数估计。该方法已成功应用于弥散张量成像（DTI）和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该模型能够有效地识别与协变量相关的网络成分并准确估计参数，并已成功应用于DTI和fMRI数据集。
AI.translation: 纵向脑成像数据有助于跨时间监测个体大脑的结构和功能变化，为理解动态神经生物学机制提供了重要基础。此类数据提高了检测疾病进展早期生物标志物的敏感性，并增强了对干预效果的评估。虽然最近的矩阵响应回归模型可以将静态脑网络与外部预测因子联系起来，但针对纵向脑网络（特别是源自高维成像数据）的统计方法仍然很少。我们引入了一种矩阵响应广义线性混合模型，该模型可以容纳纵向脑网络，并识别受外部预测因子影响的边缘连接。我们为参数估计开发了一种高效的蒙特卡洛期望最大化算法。广泛的模拟证明了协变量相关网络成分的有效识别和准确的参数估计。我们通过对扩散张量成像（DTI）和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）数据集的应用，进一步展示了所提方法的用途。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的矩阵响应广义线性混合模型，用于分析纵向脑网络，并能识别受外部预测因子影响的网络连接。研究人员开发了一种高效的MCEM算法进行参数估计，并通过模拟和实际DTI/fMRI数据验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 矩阵响应模型, 广义线性混合模型, 纵向脑网络, 脑成像数据, 蒙特卡洛EM算法
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地将矩阵响应回归模型扩展到纵向脑网络分析，解决了现有方法在处理高维纵向成像数据方面的不足。其重要性在于能够更敏感地检测疾病进展的早期生物标志物和评估干预效果。限制是该方法对计算资源可能有较高要求，且模型假设的适用性需要进一步验证。

title: Functional-SVD for Heterogeneous Trajectories: Case Studies in Health
comments: Journal of the American Statistical Association, to appear
summary: Trajectory data, including time series and longitudinal measurements, are increasingly common in health-related domains such as biomedical research and epidemiology. Real-world trajectory data frequently exhibit heterogeneity across subjects such as patients, sites, and subpopulations, yet many traditional methods are not designed to accommodate such heterogeneity in data analysis. To address this, we propose a unified framework, termed Functional Singular Value Decomposition (FSVD), for statistical learning with heterogeneous trajectories. We establish the theoretical foundations of FSVD and develop a corresponding estimation algorithm that accommodates noisy and irregular observations. We further adapt FSVD to a wide range of trajectory-learning tasks, including dimension reduction, factor modeling, regression, clustering, and data completion, while preserving its ability to account for heterogeneity, leverage inherent smoothness, and handle irregular sampling. Through extensive simulations, we demonstrate that FSVD-based methods consistently outperform existing approaches across these tasks. Finally, we apply FSVD to a COVID-19 case-count dataset and electronic health record datasets, showcasing its effective performance in global and subgroup pattern discovery and factor analysis.
comment: Journal of the American Statistical Association, to appear

AI.title_translation: 异构轨迹的函数奇异值分解：健康领域的案例研究
AI.tldr: 针对健康领域中常见的异构轨迹数据，本文提出了一个统一的框架——函数奇异值分解（FSVD）。FSVD能够处理数据的异质性、噪声和不规则采样，并适用于降维、聚类、回归等多种任务。模拟和真实案例（COVID-19、EHR）显示FSVD在模式发现和因子分析中表现优异，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 健康相关领域（如生物医学研究和流行病学）中的轨迹数据（时间序列和纵向测量）日益普遍。然而，真实的轨迹数据在受试者、地点和亚群之间经常表现出异质性，而许多传统方法并未被设计用于适应数据分析中的这种异质性。
AI.method: 提出了一种称为函数奇异值分解（FSVD）的统一框架，用于异构轨迹的统计学习。建立了理论基础，并开发了相应的估计算法，以适应有噪声和不规则的观测数据。FSVD被进一步应用于降维、因子建模、回归、聚类和数据补全等多种轨迹学习任务，同时保持了处理异质性、利用固有平滑性和处理不规则采样的能力。
AI.result: 广泛的模拟结果表明，基于FSVD的方法在这些任务中始终优于现有方法。将FSVD应用于COVID-19病例计数数据集和电子健康记录（EHR）数据集，展示了其在全局和亚组模式发现以及因子分析中的有效性能。
AI.translation: 轨迹数据，包括时间序列和纵向测量，在生物医学研究和流行病学等健康相关领域中越来越常见。现实世界中的轨迹数据经常在患者、地点和亚群等受试者之间表现出异质性，然而许多传统方法并未被设计用于适应数据分析中的这种异质性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个统一的框架，称为函数奇异值分解（FSVD），用于异构轨迹的统计学习。我们建立了FSVD的理论基础，并开发了相应的估计算法，以适应有噪声和不规则的观测数据。我们进一步将FSVD应用于广泛的轨迹学习任务，包括降维、因子建模、回归、聚类和数据补全，同时保留了其处理异质性、利用固有平滑性和处理不规则采样的能力。通过广泛的模拟，我们证明了基于FSVD的方法在这些任务中始终优于现有方法。最后，我们将FSVD应用于一个COVID-19病例计数数据集和电子健康记录数据集，展示了其在全局和亚组模式发现以及因子分析中的有效性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了函数奇异值分解（FSVD）这一统一框架，以解决健康领域中时间序列和纵向测量等异构轨迹数据的分析难题。FSVD在理论上和算法上能够处理数据的异质性、噪声和不规则采样，并可应用于降维、因子建模、回归、聚类和数据补全等多种学习任务。模拟结果表明FSVD优于现有方法，并且通过应用于COVID-19病例数据和电子健康记录，证明了其在发现全局和亚组模式方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 异构轨迹, 函数奇异值分解, 统计学习, 维度约减, 健康数据
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个统一的统计学习框架FSVD，专门用于处理健康领域中常见的异构轨迹数据。其重要性在于，FSVD克服了传统方法无法处理数据异质性、不规则采样和噪声的局限性，提供了一个多功能工具（适用于降维、聚类、回归、数据补全等）来有效地从复杂的健康数据中发现全局和亚组模式。这对于精准医学和流行病学研究具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Bayesian Estimation of Causal Effects Using Proxies of a Latent Interference Network
summary: Network interference occurs when treatments assigned to some units affect the outcomes of others. Traditional approaches often assume that the observed network correctly specifies the interference structure. However, in practice, researchers frequently only have access to proxy measurements of the interference network due to limitations in data collection or potential mismatches between measured networks and actual interference pathways. In this paper, we introduce a framework for estimating causal effects when only proxy networks are available. Our approach leverages a structural causal model that accommodates diverse proxy types, including noisy measurements, multiple data sources, and multilayer networks, and defines causal effects as interventions on population-level treatments. The latent nature of the true interference network poses significant challenges. To overcome them, we develop a Bayesian inference framework. We propose a Block Gibbs sampler with Locally Informed Proposals to update the latent network, thereby efficiently exploring the high-dimensional posterior space composed of both discrete and continuous parameters. The latent network updates are driven by information from the proxy networks, treatments, and outcomes. We illustrate the performance of our method through numerical experiments, demonstrating its accuracy in recovering causal effects even when only proxies of the interference network are available.

AI.title_translation: 使用潜在干扰网络的代理进行因果效应的贝叶斯估计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个贝叶斯框架，用于在只有潜在干扰网络的代理测量可用时，估计网络干扰下的因果效应。该方法使用一个结构因果模型来整合多种代理信息，并开发了带有局部信息提议的Block Gibbs采样器来高效推断潜在网络。
AI.motivation: 传统的因果估计方法通常假设观测到的网络准确地指定了干扰结构。然而，在实践中，由于数据收集的限制或测量网络与实际干扰路径之间的潜在不匹配，研究人员往往只能获得干扰网络的代理测量，这阻碍了准确的因果效应估计。
AI.method: 1. 引入了一个结构因果模型（Structural Causal Model），以适应各种代理类型，包括噪声测量、多源数据和多层网络。2. 定义因果效应为对群体层面治疗的干预。3. 开发了一个贝叶斯推断框架来应对真实干扰网络的潜在性质。4. 提出了一个带有局部信息提议（Locally Informed Proposals）的Block Gibbs采样器，用于更新潜在网络，从而高效探索由离散和连续参数组成的高维后验空间。潜在网络的更新由代理网络、治疗和结果的信息驱动。
AI.result: 通过数值实验证明了该方法的性能，即使只有干扰网络的代理可用，该方法也能准确地恢复因果效应。
AI.translation: 当分配给某些单元的治疗影响其他单元的结果时，就会发生网络干扰。传统方法通常假设观测到的网络正确地指定了干扰结构。然而，在实践中，由于数据收集的限制或测量网络与实际干扰路径之间的潜在不匹配，研究人员通常只能获得干扰网络的代理测量。在本文中，我们引入了一个框架，用于在只有代理网络可用时估计因果效应。我们的方法利用了一个结构因果模型，该模型适应了不同的代理类型，包括噪声测量、多源数据和多层网络，并将因果效应定义为对群体层面治疗的干预。真实干扰网络的潜在性质带来了重大挑战。为了克服这些挑战，我们开发了一个贝叶斯推断框架。我们提出了一个带有局部信息提议（Locally Informed Proposals）的Block Gibbs采样器来更新潜在网络，从而有效地探索由离散和连续参数组成的高维后验空间。潜在网络的更新由代理网络、治疗和结果的信息驱动。我们通过数值实验说明了我们方法的性能，证明了即使只有干扰网络的代理可用，它也能准确地恢复因果效应。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个贝叶斯估计框架，用于在网络干扰下，仅利用潜在干扰网络的代理测量来估计因果效应。该框架基于一个结构因果模型，可处理噪声测量、多源和多层网络等多种代理类型。为应对潜在网络的挑战，研究人员开发了带有局部信息提议的Block Gibbs采样器，以高效推断高维后验空间中的参数，数值实验证实了该方法在恢复因果效应方面的准确性。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯估计, 因果效应, 潜在干扰网络, 代理测量, Block Gibbs采样
AI.comments: 该研究的关键创新在于解决了网络因果推断中一个常见且重要的问题：真实干扰网络是潜在的且仅能通过代理（如不完美的测量）获取。通过引入一个能够整合多种代理类型（噪声、多源、多层）的结构因果模型，并结合专门的贝叶斯采样器（带有局部信息提议的Block Gibbs），该方法为处理复杂的网络数据缺失/不匹配问题提供了强大的工具。这一框架对于需要进行精确因果推断但受限于不完整或有偏差网络数据的领域（如社交网络、公共卫生干预）具有重要意义。潜在网络的高维离散-连续后验空间是主要的计算挑战，该文提出的特定Block Gibbs采样器是解决这一挑战的核心。

title: Efficient and Robust Block Designs for Order-of-Addition Experiments
summary: Designs for Order-of-Addition (OofA) experiments have received growing attention due to their impact on responses based on the sequence of component addition. In certain cases, these experiments involve heterogeneous groups of units, which necessitates the use of blocking to manage variation effects. Despite this, the exploration of block OofA designs remains limited in the literature. As experiments become increasingly complex, addressing this gap is essential to ensure that the designs accurately reflect the effects of the addition sequence and effectively handle the associated variability. Motivated by this, this paper seeks to address the gap by expanding the indicator function framework for block OofA designs. We propose the use of the word length pattern as a criterion for selecting robust block OofA designs. To improve search efficiency and reduce computational demands, we develop algorithms that employ orthogonal Latin squares for design construction and selection, minimizing the need for exhaustive searches. Our analysis, supported by correlation plots, reveals that the algorithms effectively manage confounding and aliasing between effects. Additionally, simulation studies indicate that designs based on our proposed criterion and algorithms achieve power and type I error rates comparable to those of full block OofA designs. This approach offers a practical and efficient method for constructing block OofA designs and may provide valuable insights for future research and applications.

AI.title_translation: 高效且稳健的添加顺序实验分块设计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效稳健的算法，用于构建添加顺序（OofA）实验的分块设计，该设计在保证性能的同时，显著减少了计算需求。
AI.motivation: 添加顺序（OofA）实验很重要，但当实验单元具有异质性时，需要分块来控制变异。文献中对分块OofA设计的研究有限，需要填补这一空白以应对日益复杂的实验。
AI.method: 扩展了分块OofA设计的指示函数框架。提出使用字长模式作为选择稳健分块OofA设计的标准。开发了利用正交拉丁方进行设计构建和选择的算法，以提高搜索效率并减少穷尽搜索。
AI.result: 算法有效地管理了效应之间的混淆和别名。模拟研究表明，基于所提标准和算法的设计，其功效和I型错误率与全分块OofA设计相当。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为构建分块OofA设计提供了一种实用且高效的方法，并可能为未来的研究和应用提供有价值的见解。
AI.translation: 添加顺序（OofA）实验设计因其对基于组分添加顺序的响应的影响而受到越来越多的关注。在某些情况下，这些实验涉及异质的实验单元组，这使得有必要使用分块来管理变异效应。尽管如此，文献中对分块OofA设计的探索仍然有限。随着实验变得越来越复杂，解决这一差距对于确保设计准确反映添加顺序的影响并有效处理相关变异至关重要。受此启发，本文旨在通过扩展分块OofA设计的指示函数框架来解决这一差距。我们建议使用字长模式作为选择稳健分块OofA设计的标准。为了提高搜索效率并减少计算需求，我们开发了利用正交拉丁方进行设计构建和选择的算法，从而最大限度地减少了对穷尽搜索的需求。我们的分析（由相关图支持）表明，这些算法有效地管理了效应之间的混淆和别名。此外，模拟研究表明，基于我们提出的标准和算法的设计，其功效和I型错误率与全分块OofA设计相当。这种方法为构建分块OofA设计提供了一种实用且高效的方法，并可能为未来的研究和应用提供有价值的见解。
AI.summary: 本文针对添加顺序（OofA）实验中缺乏稳健分块设计的问题，扩展了指示函数框架，并提出了使用字长模式作为设计选择标准。为提高效率，研究开发了利用正交拉丁方构建分块OofA设计的算法。分析和模拟结果表明，该算法能有效管理混淆，且所得设计在功效和I型错误率上与全分块设计相当，提供了一种实用且高效的设计构建方法。
AI.keywords: 添加顺序实验, 分块设计, 指示函数, 字长模式, 正交拉丁方
AI.comments: 创新点在于将指示函数框架和字长模式标准应用于分块添加顺序（OofA）设计的复杂结构，并开发了利用正交拉丁方的高效算法来避免计算量巨大的穷尽搜索。重要性在于为处理具有异质性单元的实际OofA实验提供了必要的、稳健的统计设计工具。局限性：摘要中未提及。

title: Habit Formation, Labor Supply, and the Dynamics of Retirement and Annuitization
summary: The decision to annuitize wealth in retirement planning has become increasingly complex due to rising longevity risk and changing retirement patterns, including increased labor force participation at older ages. While an extensive literature studies consumption, labor, and annuitization decisions, these elements are typically examined in isolation. This paper develops a unified stochastic control and optimal stopping framework in which habit formation and endogenous labor supply shape retirement and annuitization decisions under age-dependent mortality. We derive optimal consumption, labor, portfolio, and annuitization policies in a continuous-time lifecycle model. The solution is characterized via dynamic programming and a Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman variational inequality. Our results reveal a rich sequence of retirement dynamics. When wealth is low relative to habit, labor is supplied defensively to protect consumption standards. As wealth increases, agents enter a work-to-retire phase in which labor is supplied at its maximum level to accelerate access to retirement. Human capital acts as a stabilizing asset, justifying a more aggressive pre-retirement investment portfolio, followed by abrupt de-risking upon annuitization. Subjective mortality beliefs are a key determinant in shaping retirement dynamics. Agents with pessimistic longevity beliefs rationally perceive annuities as unattractive, leading them to avoid or delay annuitization. This framework provides a behavior-based explanation for low annuity demand and offers guidance for retirement planning jointly linking labor supply, portfolio choice, and the timing of annuitization.

AI.title_translation: 习惯形成、劳动力供给与退休和年金化的动态
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的随机控制模型，将习惯形成和内生劳动供给纳入退休和年金化决策。结果显示，财富水平和习惯决定了劳动供给策略（防御性工作或加速退休），人力资本支持激进的投资组合，而悲观的寿命信念是年金需求低迷的关键行为原因。
AI.motivation: 由于寿命风险增加和退休模式变化（老年人劳动参与增加），年金化决策日益复杂。现有文献通常孤立地研究消费、劳动和年金化决策，因此需要一个统一的框架来共同分析这些相互关联的要素。
AI.method: 采用统一的随机控制和最优停止框架（stochastic control and optimal stopping framework），将习惯形成和内生劳动供给纳入年龄依赖的死亡率模型中。在一个连续时间生命周期模型中推导了最优消费、劳动、投资组合和年金化策略。解决方案通过动态规划和Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) 变分不等式来表征。
AI.result: 揭示了丰富的退休动态序列：1. 当财富相对于习惯较低时，劳动供给具有防御性，以保护消费标准。2. 随着财富增加，代理人进入“为退休而工作”阶段，最大化劳动供给以加速退休。3. 人力资本是稳定资产，支持退休前更激进的投资组合，但在年金化后立即去风险化。4. 主观死亡率信念是关键决定因素；悲观的寿命信念使代理人认为年金缺乏吸引力，从而避免或延迟年金化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为低年金需求提供了一种基于行为的解释，并为联合关联劳动供给、投资组合选择和年金化时机的退休规划提供了指导。
AI.translation: 由于寿命风险增加和退休模式变化（包括老年人劳动参与度提高），退休规划中将财富年金化的决策变得日益复杂。尽管大量文献研究了消费、劳动和年金化决策，但这些要素通常是孤立研究的。本文提出了一个统一的随机控制和最优停止框架，其中习惯形成和内生劳动供给在年龄依赖的死亡率下共同塑造退休和年金化决策。我们在一个连续时间生命周期模型中推导了最优消费、劳动、投资组合和年金化策略。该解决方案通过动态规划和Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman变分不等式来表征。我们的结果揭示了丰富的退休动态序列。当财富相对于习惯较低时，劳动供给具有防御性，旨在保护消费标准。随着财富增加，代理人进入“为退休而工作”阶段，以最大化劳动供给来加速获得退休。人力资本充当稳定资产，证明了退休前更激进的投资组合是合理的，随后在年金化时突然去风险化。主观死亡率信念是塑造退休动态的关键决定因素。具有悲观寿命信念的代理人理性地认为年金没有吸引力，导致他们避免或延迟年金化。该框架为低年金需求提供了一种基于行为的解释，并为联合关联劳动供给、投资组合选择和年金化时机的退休规划提供了指导。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个统一的、包含习惯形成和内生劳动供给的随机控制和最优停止框架，用于分析连续时间生命周期模型中的消费、劳动、投资组合和年金化决策。研究发现，退休动态与财富和习惯水平密切相关：低财富时防御性工作，高财富时加速退休。人力资本支持激进的退休前投资组合。此外，主观的悲观寿命信念是导致低年金需求的关键行为因素。该模型提供了一个整合劳动供给、投资组合和年金化时机的退休规划指导。
AI.keywords: 习惯形成, 劳动供给, 年金化, 随机控制, 退休动态
AI.comments: 本文的创新性在于将习惯形成和内生劳动供给这两个重要的行为经济学因素，整合到一个统一的随机控制框架中，来同时解决退休、投资和年金化这三个相互关联的难题。这克服了现有文献孤立研究这些决策的局限性。通过引入主观死亡率信念，该模型成功地为现实世界中普遍存在的低年金需求现象提供了一个基于行为的、具有说服力的解释。对于养老金设计和个人退休规划具有重要的实际指导意义。

title: Dual Attainment in Multi-Period Multi-Asset Martingale Optimal Transport and Its Computation
summary: We establish dual attainment for the multimarginal, multi-asset martingale optimal transport (MOT) problem, a fundamental question in the mathematical theory of model-independent pricing and hedging in quantitative finance. Our main result proves the existence of dual optimizers under mild regularity and irreducibility conditions, extending previous duality and attainment results from the classical and two-marginal settings to arbitrary numbers of assets and time periods. This theoretical advance provides a rigorous foundation for robust pricing and hedging of complex, path-dependent financial derivatives. To support our analysis, we present numerical experiments that demonstrate the practical solvability of large-scale discrete MOT problems using the state-of-the-art primal-dual linear programming (PDLP) algorithm. In particular, we solve multi-dimensional (or vectorial) MOT instances arising from the robust pricing of worst-of autocallable options, confirming the accuracy and feasibility of our theoretical results. Our work advances the mathematical understanding of MOT and highlights its relevance for robust financial engineering in high-dimensional and model-uncertain environments.

AI.title_translation: 多期多资产鞅最优传输中的对偶可达性及其计算
AI.tldr: 本文在多期多资产鞅最优传输 (MOT) 中建立了对偶可达性，证明了对偶最优解的存在性，并使用PDLP算法成功地对大规模离散MOT问题进行了数值求解，为高维金融衍生品的稳健定价提供了严格的理论和计算基础。
AI.motivation: 鞅最优传输 (MOT) 是量化金融中模型无关定价和对冲的数学理论中的一个基本问题。作者旨在为多边际、多资产的MOT问题建立对偶可达性，并提供严谨的理论基础和计算方法，以支持复杂、路径依赖型金融衍生品的稳健定价和对冲。
AI.method: 1. **理论方法：** 证明在温和的正则性和不可约性条件下，对偶最优解的存在性，将先前的结果扩展到任意数量的资产和时间周期。2. **计算方法：** 采用最先进的原对偶线性规划 (PDLP) 算法对大规模离散MOT问题进行数值实验。
AI.result: 1. **理论结果：** 成功证明了多边际、多资产MOT问题中对偶最优解的存在性。2. **应用结果：** 成功求解了源自“最差表现可赎回期权”（worst-of autocallable options）稳健定价的多维MOT实例，证实了理论结果的准确性和可行性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作推进了对鞅最优传输的数学理解，并突显了其在高维和模型不确定环境中对稳健金融工程的实际意义和相关性。该理论进展为复杂、路径依赖型金融衍生品的稳健定价和对冲提供了严格的基础。
AI.translation: 我们为多边际、多资产鞅最优传输 (MOT) 问题建立了对偶可达性，这是量化金融中模型无关定价和对冲数学理论中的一个基本问题。我们的主要结果是在温和的正则性和不可约性条件下证明了对偶最优解的存在性，将先前关于对偶性和可达性的结果从经典和两边际设置扩展到任意数量的资产和时间周期。这一理论进展为复杂、路径依赖型金融衍生品的稳健定价和对冲提供了严格的基础。为了支持我们的分析，我们提出了数值实验，使用最先进的原对偶线性规划 (PDLP) 算法来证明大规模离散MOT问题的实际可解性。特别是，我们求解了源自“最差表现可赎回期权”稳健定价的多维（或向量）MOT实例，证实了我们理论结果的准确性和可行性。我们的工作推进了对MOT的数学理解，并突出了其在高维和模型不确定环境中对稳健金融工程的相关性。
AI.summary: 本文研究多期多资产鞅最优传输 (MOT) 问题，成功建立了对偶可达性，并证明了在温和条件下对偶最优解的存在性。这一理论成果将现有的对偶性结果扩展到了多资产、多周期场景，为路径依赖型金融衍生品的稳健定价奠定了严格的数学基础。此外，通过使用先进的原对偶线性规划 (PDLP) 算法进行大规模数值计算，作者验证了理论的可行性，并将其应用于“最差表现可赎回期权”的稳健定价。
AI.keywords: 鞅最优传输, 对偶可达性, 模型无关定价, PDLP算法, 稳健金融工程
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将鞅最优传输 (MOT) 理论中的对偶可达性结果扩展到了迄今为止最复杂、最具现实意义的设置：多期、多资产（多边际）。在金融工程中，由于模型不确定性和高维特性，稳健定价一直是一个重大挑战。通过严格证明对偶最优解的存在性，作者为基于MOT的稳健定价和对冲提供了关键的理论支撑。此外，结合最先进的原对偶线性规划 (PDLP) 算法来解决大规模离散问题，凸显了该理论在实际应用中的可行性，特别是在处理复杂的结构化产品（如“最差表现可赎回期权”）方面具有重要意义。
